learning_outcomes.text: Students know the most important material-specific properties of selected steels.
They understand the practical relevance of steel characteristic values and can present and explain them.
Students are able to describe the thermal treatment and surface layer modification of steel alloys.
They can explain the metallophysical background of the behavior in manufacturing processes.

syllabus_topics: Metallophysical backgrounds for the development of high-strength fine-grain structural steels
Car body steels: material characteristic values and formability
Case hardening, nitriding, surface hardening, boriding
Tool steels: selection and heat treatment
assessment_rules: The assessment method (exam or written elaboration with presentation) will be determined at the beginning of the lecture. The module exam must be passed to receive credit points. The grade weighting follows the ECTS credit points.
